purpose: Define durable agent identity and bounded operation independently of whichever LLM, model, tool or interface happens to serve the agent.

model_binding.output_rule: all model outputs carry model/provider/version where available, tool/source provenance, epistemic state and scope

memory_model.rule: temporary or personal context does not silently enter business/domain canon

action_model.propose: may reason and create bounded delta without execution authority
action_model.simulate: may use sandbox/digital twin only from a corpus-bound packet and admitted capability; results are unknown until execution and remain subject to proof/readback/commit
action_model.execute: requires execution lease, assurance/custodial preflights as applicable, tool permission and safe-state path
action_model.publish: requires evidence ceiling + security/privacy + release authority
action_model.spawn_child: requires separate identity and explicit parent-authority/replication budget

execution_lease.rule: actual execution requires a current scoped lease; historical approvals and tool availability are not substitutes

runtime_entrypoint.rule: consequential execution enters through evidence/assurance/custodial/lease/safe-state envelope before delegating to Neo-supervised floors

test_simulation_binding.rule: compile a bounded corpus packet first; unresolved source/measurement/dependency inputs HOLD rather than being generated
test_simulation_binding.result_rule: result values enter semantic state only from receipted execution and remain derived/empirical according to the executor method
test_simulation_binding.activation_rule: prepared code does not imply agent/provider/local connection activation
